newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Visitor arrivals to NZ rise 6 pct in Sept quarter.
newsitem.headline: Visitor arrivals to NZ rise 6 pct in Sept quarter.

text.p: Visitor arrivals to New Zealand rose 17,100, six percent, to 307,700 in the September quarter over the September 1995 quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.
In the quarter there was a net gain of 6230 permanent and long-term migrants, down 26 percent on the September 1995 quarter.
There was a net gain from Asia of 5090 migrants, down 18 percent and a net inflow of 1,540 from Europe.
There was a net outflow of 2620 migrants from New Zealand to Australia, 510 more than in the September 1995 quarter.

Visitor arrivals from Australia rose 4 percent while arrivals from Asia rose six percent. Arrivals from Korea rose 18 percent and it overtook the U.S. as the third largest source of tourists, with Japan second.
The number of New Zealanders taking short trips overseas totalled 334,900 in the September quarter, up 17 percent on the September 1995 quarter.
